question: After conflict resolution and exact-head recipient proof, should `imsg` support sticker sending as a maintained bridge-only public CLI and RPC contract?
rationale: Tests can validate parsing and defensive boundaries, but they cannot decide whether the repository should permanently support a public feature backed by private IMCore behavior and its ongoing OS compatibility burden.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Ship the narrow fail-closed command and RPC method after a clean rebase and successful standalone plus exact-part attached recipient proof.

options.title: Keep experimental
options.body: Expose the capability only as explicitly unstable bridge functionality until broader macOS compatibility evidence exists.

options.title: Decline support
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers do not want to own the private-framework maintenance and compatibility burden.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Ship the narrow fail-closed command and RPC method after a clean rebase and successful standalone plus exact-part attached recipient proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current contract and trust-boundary rewrite plus the overlapping main-side infrastructure changes that must be integrated.
